name: tempo-local

scripts.setup: bun install --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile && bun scripts/setup-electron.ts && bun run native:rebuild && bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd electron-app build:assets
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:shared && bun run build:server && bun run --cwd electron-app typecheck
scripts.test:electron: cd electron-app && bun test tests src/renderer/src/lib src/renderer/src/utils scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.test: bun run test:server && bun run test:electron && bun run test:installer
scripts.test:integration: cd server && bun scripts/verify-local-auth.ts && bun scripts/verify-legacy-import.ts && bun scripts/verify-personalized-classification.ts && bun scripts/verify-system-boundaries.ts && bun scripts/verify-reminders.ts && bun scripts/verify-calendar.ts
scripts.test:native: cd electron-app && bun run test:notch-animation-policy && bun run test:notch-interaction-layout && bun run test:notch-overlap && bun run test:native-lifecycle
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:server && bun run --cwd electron-app build:mac:local

description: Local macOS focus companion derived from Cronus
